cjk.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT p.slug, p.id as page_id, p.title, p.type, p.source_id, p.effective_date, p.effective_date_source, CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(p.frontmatter->>'message_id', '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', '', 'g'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN p.frontmatter->>'message_id' END AS message_id, p.frontmatter->>'thread_id' AS thread_id, CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(p.frontmatter->>'message_id', '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', '', 'g'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(p.frontmatter->>'subject', '') END AS source_subject, cc.id as chunk_id, cc.chunk_index, cc.chunk_text, cc.chunk_source, ((((LENGTH(cc.chunk_text) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cc.chunk_text, $1, ''))) / NULLIF(LENGTH($2), 0)::real) + ((LENGTH(cc.chunk_text) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cc.chunk_text, $3, ''))) / NULLIF(LENGTH($4), 0)::real) + ((LENGTH(cc.chunk_text) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cc.chunk_text, $5, ''))) / NULLIF(LENGTH($6), 0)::real) + COALESCE(1.0 / NULLIF(POSITION($7 IN cc.chunk_text), 0)::real, 0.0)) * (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'provenance') = 'auto-extracted' AND (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'status') = 'unverified' THEN 1.0 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'media/articles/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'openclaw/chat/%' THEN 0.5 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'media/repos/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'originals/%' THEN 1.5 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'companies/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'concepts/%' THEN 1.3 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'meetings/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'extracts/%' THEN 0.3 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'writing/%' THEN 1.4 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'media/x/%' THEN 0.7 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'archive/%' THEN 0.5 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'people/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'deals/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'civic/%' THEN 1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'daily/%' THEN 0.8 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'yc/%' THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 END)) AS score, CASE WHEN p.updated_at < ( SELECT MAX(te.created_at) FROM timeline_entries te WHERE te.page_id = p.id ) THEN true ELSE false END AS stale FROM content_chunks cc JOIN pages p ON p.id = cc.page_id JOIN sources s ON s.id = p.source_id WHERE cc.chunk_text LIKE $8 ESCAPE '\' AND cc.chunk_text LIKE $9 ESCAPE '\' AND NOT (p.slug LIKE 'test/%' OR p.slug LIKE 'attachments/%' OR p.slug LIKE '.raw/%' OR p.slug LIKE 'docs/inbox/%') AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.text_projection_revision = p.knowledge_revision) IS TRUE AND NOT s.archived AND NOT (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine') AND cc.modality = 'text' ORDER BY score DESC, page_id ASC, chunk_id ASC LIMIT $10 ), best_per_page AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(source_id, 'default'), slug) * FROM ranked ORDER BY COALESCE(source_id, 'default'), slug, score DESC, page_id ASC, chunk_id ASC ) SELECT * FROM best_per_page ORDER BY score DESC, page_id ASC, chunk_id ASC LIMIT $11 OFFSET $12
